title: ARTA: Graph Combinatorial Optimization for Robust Interbeat Interval Estimation from Wearable Electrocardiogram Signals
abstract: arXiv:2611.00011v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate heart rate (HR) and interbeat interval (IBI) estimation from wearable electrocardiogram (ECG) is essential for continuous physiological monitoring, but motion artifacts can create false QRS-like peaks and obscure true R-peaks. Conventional detectors and local interval-repair rules process detections independently and may become unreliable when several consecutive beats are corrupted. We present ARTA (Artifact-Robust Temporal Alignment), a graph-based combinatorial framework that estimates the heartbeat sequence through constrained temporal optimization. ARTA combines candidates from multiple ECG detectors, represents them as nodes in a directed acyclic graph and connects candidates through physiologically plausible RR intervals. Candidate confidence uses detector agreement and local ECG quality, while history-dependent transition costs capture recent IBI consistency and a soft heart-rate prior. Beam-search dynamic programming

translated_title: ARTA：基于图组合优化的可穿戴心电信号心跳间期鲁棒估计
translated_abstract: 从可穿戴心电图（ECG）中准确估计心率（HR）和心跳间期（IBI）对于连续生理监测至关重要，但运动伪影可能产生类似QRS波群的虚假峰值并掩盖真实的R波峰。传统检测器和局部间期修复规则独立处理各个检测结果，当多个连续心跳受到干扰时可能变得不可靠。我们提出了ARTA（Artifact-Robust Temporal Alignment，抗伪影时间对齐），这是一个基于图的组合优化框架，通过受约束的时间优化来估计心跳序列。ARTA整合来自多个ECG检测器的候选结果，将其表示为有向无环图中的节点，并通过生理上合理的RR间期将候选点连接起来。候选点置信度结合了检测器之间的一致性和局部ECG质量，而依赖历史的转移代价则捕捉近期IBI的一致性和软性心率先验。束搜索动态规划……
tldr: 提出ARTA框架，通过将多检测器候选点构建为有向无环图并利用束搜索动态规划进行受约束的时间优化，从而在运动伪影干扰下从可穿戴ECG信号中鲁棒地估计心跳间期。
en_tdlr: ARTA is a graph-based combinatorial optimization framework that combines candidates from multiple ECG detectors into a directed acyclic graph and applies beam-search dynamic programming to robustly estimate interbeat intervals from wearable ECG despite motion artifacts.
